item.title: Supreme Court to hear Trump challenge to protected status for Syrian, Haitian nationals in US
item.summary: The Supreme Court will review Trump's effort to unwind legal protections for migrants from Haiti and Syria, and will hear arguments in the case next month.

item.title: Trump Kennedy Center's board votes unanimously to approve $257M renovations and two-year closure
item.summary: Trump Kennedy Center board voted to shut down the performing arts venue for a 2-year renovation despite critics arguing the $257 million project lacks proper congressional oversight.

item.title: Democratic congressman lashes out at aviation analyst over 'stupid' DHS shutdown comments
item.summary: Rep. Adam Smith responded after former DOT Inspector General Mary Schiavo sharply criticized Congress over the TSA funding dispute tied to the federal spending standoff.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: GOP weighs 'nuking' filibuster to pass Trump's SAVE Act
item.summary: Senate Republicans face an uphill battle in passing Trump's SAVE America Act requiring citizenship proof for voting as Democrats threaten to use filibuster.

item.title: Darius Slay, 6-time Pro Bowl cornerback, announces retirement after 13 NFL seasons
item.summary: Six-time Pro Bowl cornerback Darius Slay announced his NFL retirement after 13 seasons on Monday, ending his career with 28 interceptions and a Super Bowl championship ring.

item.title: Cornyn clashes with progressive Rep Greg Casar in heated airport face-off over DHS shutdown
item.summary: Texas Sen. John Cornyn and Rep. Greg Casar clashed over the DHS shutdown as TSA workers missed their first paycheck and airport delays continue to mount.

item.title: Jerry O’Connell claims wife, daughters ‘became physical’ after his comments about Harris losing to Trump
item.summary: Actor Jerry O'Connell told a story about his wife Rebecca Romijn after former Vice President Kamala Harris lost the 2024 election on Bill Maher's podcast.

item.title: TSA officers skip work as paychecks stop during shutdown, airports face chaos nationwide
item.summary: TSA officers miss paychecks during government shutdown, leading to 10% call-out rates nationwide and massive airport security delays across the country.

item.title: Mexican illegal alien allegedly used Roblox currency to solicit explicit content from kids under 10
item.summary: Mexican illegal immigrant allegedly used Roblox game currency to solicit explicit content from children under 10. ICE seeks arrest after Virginia release.

item.title: Greg Bovino, face of Trump’s mass deportation campaign, to retire after controversial Minneapolis raids
item.summary: U.S. Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino, the face of President Trump’s mass deportation surge, will retire after fatal shootings and controversy in Minneapolis.
